description: This file defines the class `GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate`, a specialized display field used within the OrangeHRM reporting module, which supports aggregate functions (such as MIN) for display fields in reports.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A display field class that supports aggregate functions for report display, extending `GenericBasicDisplayField`.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets entity alias, field, and aggregate based on the DisplayField's alias.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Returns the currently set aggregate function.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Returns the SQL SELECT part with aggregate, entity alias, and field.
